relocation_strict.reason: The candidate is not byte-identical, has a different size, and has two additional R_PPC_REL24 relocations for _savegpr_27 and _restgpr_27; relocation offsets after the prologue also diverge.

divergence: With the pre-existing canonical settings, GC/1.3 emits addi/bl _savegpr_27 and addi/bl _restgpr_27 instead of retail stmw r27,0x8c(r1) and lmw r27,0x8c(r1), introducing two call relocations. The candidate is 24 bytes larger overall. It rotates table/first_count/second_count through r31/r30/r29 instead of retail r29/r31/r30 and scale/frame through f31/f30 instead of retail f30/f31. Four flag clears lower to constant materialization plus and rather than retail rlwinm, the frame-equality test has a shorter branch shape, and several slot-array accesses use indexed addressing instead of retail add-plus-displacement.
